defect.symptom: Failed to send resume prompt: There is no current event loop in thread 'asyncio_2'.
defect.root_cause: The code used asyncio.get_event_loop(), which returns the event loop bound to the calling thread. _resolve_resume_checkpoint_decision is called from a thread-pool / sync context ('asyncio_2') that has no bound loop. The gateway's actual asyncio loop is stored in self._gateway_loop (set in the main async run coroutine), but the method ignored it.

fix.description: Changed the resume-prompt coroutine scheduling to use self._gateway_loop (the gateway's main event loop) as the target loop, falling back to asyncio.get_event_loop() only when the attribute is unavailable.
fix.diff: - loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()\n+ loop = getattr(self, "_gateway_loop", None) or asyncio.get_event_loop()
